rows.en: It's incredibly hot... And the Minus Energy, too...
At this rate, we can't even get close to it.
But if we don't stop it, the base will be destroyed.
But if we don't do it, the base is gonna get wrecked.
However, if we do not stop it, the base will be destroyed.
Even so, if we don't stop it, our base will be destroyed.
But if we don't stop it, the base will be destroyed.
But if we don't do something, the base will be wiped out.
However, if we do not stop it, the base will be destroyed.
But if we don't stop it, the base will be destroyed.
But if we don't stop it, the base will be destroyed!!
However, if we do not stop it, the base will be destroyed!!
But if we don't stop it, the base will be destroyed!!
Yeah, but!! If we don't do it, the base is gonna get wrecked, isn't it!!
But if we don't do it, the base'll get blown to pieces!!
But if we don't do it, the base will be destroyed!!
...Guess we can't afford to say that, huh. If the base is destroyed, we won't stand a chance...
We're out of time. I'll go...
You...! You'll die, you know!?
Life is cheap. Especially mine...
Restoring the world took something more than "power"...
It took a strong "heart" that never yields to evil and keeps fighting to the very end!!
I will stop the Libra Cannon!! You all go on ahead!!
Epyon!!
Stop the Colony Laser!!
Reborns' true aim is the Colony Laser!!
With that, Epyon shoved Wing Zero and the others out of the room.
Farewell!!
Epyon...!!
Restoring the world took something more than "power"...
It took a strong "heart" that never yields to evil and keeps fighting to the very end!!
I will stop the Libra Cannon!! You all go on ahead!!
Hey, you!!
Stop the Colony Laser!!
Reborns' true aim is the Colony Laser!!
With that, Epyon shoved {8074} and the others out of the room.
Farewell!!
...Epyon.
...Epyon.
...Epyon.
...Epyon.
...Epyon.
...Epyon.
...Epyon.
...Epyon.
...Epyon.
...Epyon.
...Epyon.
...Epyon.
...Epyon.
...Epyon.
Epyon, huh...
...Hey, we've got no time to get sentimental. The Colony Laser's still out there, remember?
"Beep, beep, beep, beep"
...It's a transmission.
"Hey!! You destroyed Libra, didn't you!? That sound just now was it, right!?"
Yeah.
"Nice going!!"
How're things on your end?
"We're fine. We took care of the Virgos. Now we're chasing down Gaddess. She got away!"
"Now all that's left is the Colony Laser!"
But we don't know where it is.
"...Unfortunately, we don't have any info on it either."
"Thing is, a Colony Laser is a whole 6 kilometers across..."
"Even if it got resized when it was absorbed, I bet it's still pretty huge."
I know. The O showed me its blueprints once before.
"Right. Sounds like that guy was researching it. If it's finished, we're in trouble."
Yeah. We'll find some way to stop it.
"I'm counting on you to destroy it!"
Right, guess we'll just push on ahead for now.
Okay, let's just push on ahead for now.
Leave it to us!! All right! Let's push on ahead!!
Understood. We're moving on.
Roger. Standing still won't change anything... We're moving on.
Leave it to us! Now, let's move on ahead!

notes.note: Labelled Ankh, but its text is identical to leader variants 0.7/0.10/0.12 of the reaction block in story_131 (0.2-0.16 = 15 rows vs 14 in later blocks); it may be a 15th variant. Translated identically to those rows.

Leader-variant block 0.18-0.31: identical Japanese given identical English; formal 'we'(wareware) variants -> 'However, if we do not...'; rough variants (0.19, 0.29, 0.30) -> 'gonna get wrecked' / 'blown to pieces'; 0.31 polite (Mebius).
Ankh retracting his own 'can't even get close' (0.17) after the leader insists; 'to mo itte rarenai ka' -> 'Guess we can't afford to say that'.
Heero's well-known line from Gundam Wing, rendered with the standard 'Life is cheap. Especially mine.'
Epyon's two-row speech (0.44-0.45, repeated 0.62-0.63): split at the source boundary; source corner brackets -> double quotes around "power" and "heart".
{8074}-tachi -> '{8074} and the others', matching the Wing Zero branch (0.50).
Unlabelled; likely the leader or Wing Zero after the explosion. Kept neutral 'Epyon, huh...'. Source has a trailing line break, dropped.
Comm beeps in double quotes as in story_115/118; source has no trailing ellipsis here, so none added.
Labelled Ankh: Ankh says The O once showed him the blueprints (consistent with story_133 0653#0.35, also Ankh). Kept as labelled.
Unlabelled (probably Ankh). Subject not stated; used 'We'll' since Duo answers to the group ('counting on you') and the leaders reply 'Leave it to us'.
Leader-variant block 0.109-0.122 (continues into story_133). 'Makasete oke' answers Duo's request -> 'Leave it to us' (team offering itself). 0.112 curt (Heero), 0.113 'Roger' (Setsuna).

report: 80/80 rows examined. Uncertain: 0.16 (Ankh label vs identical leader-variant text), 0.91 unlabelled speaker, 0.107 unlabelled speaker/subject ('we'). No names outside the glossary.
